entries.title: Kiharu TVC overview
entries.text: Kiharu Technical & Vocational College is a TVETA- and CDACC-accredited institution located in Gaturi Ward, Kiambugi Shopping Centre, Murang'a County. The college offers certificate, diploma, artisan, and short course programmes across technical, business, hospitality, tourism, fashion, computing, cosmetology and social work disciplines. It emphasizes practical skills, industry alignment, and community-focused training.

entries.title: Contact information
entries.text: Kiharu TVC contact details are: Physical Address: Gaturi Ward, Kiambugi Shopping Centre, Murang'a County, 17Kms Along Murang'a Kiria-ini Road. Postal Address: P.O. Box 29-10200. Phone: 0720 657 630 / 0748 658 276. Office Hours: Mon–Fri 8AM–5PM.

entries.title: College location
entries.text: Kiharu TVC is located on the Murang'a Kiria-ini Road in Gaturi Ward, Kiambugi Shopping Centre. Visitors should use the college name and local area as guidance. The website also provides a location section that can show the official map embed once available.

entries.title: Admissions information
entries.text: Kiharu TVC has January, May and September intakes, while short courses have rolling admissions. The application process starts by choosing a programme, collecting an application form from the Registrar's Office or downloading one from the institution website, and submitting the required documents. Applicants should provide a KCSE or KCPE certificate or result slip, National ID or Birth Certificate, two passport-size photographs and the application fee receipt. Successful applicants receive an official admission letter within five working days. On the reporting date, students clear fees, collect their student ID and officially register.

entries.title: Application process
entries.text: The application process at Kiharu TVC involves choosing the programme that matches career goals, collecting the application form, completing and submitting the required documents, and waiting for the admission letter. After admission, students should clear fees, collect their student ID and officially register on the reporting date.

entries.title: Entry requirements
entries.text: Kiharu TVC entry requirements are: KCSE mean grade C- and above for diploma programmes (Level 6); KCSE mean grade D and above for Certificate courses (Level 5); KCSE mean grade D- and below for Artisan Certificate courses (Level 4); and KCPE and above for Level 3 courses. Short courses have rolling admissions.

entries.title: Fees and finance
entries.text: Kiharu TVC modularised fees, according to the fees structure dated 20 March 2026, are: Module 1 training fee KSh 22,396, registration fee KSh 500, student ID card KSh 500, student welfare KSh 1,000, TVETA fee KSh 500, and KUCCPS fee KSh 1,500, making a total of KSh 26,396 for Module 1. Module 2 total fees are KSh 22,396 and Module 3 total fees are KSh 22,396. The additional KSh 4,000 in registration, ID, welfare, TVETA and KUCCPS charges is paid once in Module 1, mainly by new students. The number of modules depends on the course and level. Fees can be paid through KCB Bank Murang'a Branch account 1314152238 or Equity Bank Murang'a Branch account 02202859114440. Banker's cheques should be payable to Kiharu Technical and Vocational College. Cash and personal cheques are not accepted.

entries.title: Short courses
entries.text: Kiharu TVC offers the following short courses: Phone Repair, Painting, Web Design, Cyber Security and Use of AI Tools, Barbering, Graphic Design, Pizza Making, Computer Packages, Cake Making, Computer Repair and Maintenance, Welding and Fabrication, Tiling and Flooring, Glazing, Pipe Fitting and Installation, Photovoltaic Solar Installer, AutoCAD and ArchiCAD, Basic Cookery Skills, and Manicure and Pedicure. Short courses have rolling admissions.

entries.title: Job adverts
entries.text: Job adverts at Kiharu TVC are published on the public website. Current openings include lecturers, accounts assistants, finance officers, procurement officers, and student finance officers. Interested candidates are encouraged to apply by email to the addresses shown or to submit documents to the Principal's Office.

entries.title: Tenders and procurement
entries.text: Tenders and procurement notices are published on the Kiharu TVC website. Eligible suppliers and contractors may download tender documents from the Procurement Office and submit sealed bids before the stated deadlines. The college follows the Public Procurement and Asset Disposal Act, 2015.

entries.title: Service charter
entries.text: Kiharu TVC's service charter is displayed on the website as a public commitment to transparent, accountable and quality service delivery. It is intended to guide students, staff and stakeholders on the institution's standards and values.

entries.title: Accreditation
entries.text: Kiharu Technical & Vocational College is a TVETA-approved institution and offers CDACC-accredited programmes. The college is described as an equal-opportunity institution that complies with national accreditation standards.

entries.title: Programmes offered
entries.text: Kiharu TVC offers more than 50 programmes and over 30 short courses across technical, business, hospitality, tourism, fashion, computing, cosmetology and social work fields. Long courses include diplomas and certificates in building and civil engineering, mechanical and automotive engineering, electrical and electronics engineering, computing and informatics, business and liberal studies, fashion and design, cosmetology, hospitality, social work, and tourism management.

entries.title: Building & Civil Engineering
entries.text: Building & Civil Engineering at Kiharu TVC is offered as a diploma and certificate programme. The curriculum includes Module 1: Introduction to Building Construction; Module 2: Masonry and Concrete Work; Module 3: Carpentry and Timber Work; Module 4: Surveying and Site Engineering; Module 5: Electrical and Plumbing Installation; and Module 6: Project Management and Documentation.

entries.title: Business & Liberal Studies
entries.text: Business & Liberal Studies at Kiharu TVC covers diploma and certificate pathways. Modules include Business Fundamentals, Accounting Principles, Financial Management, Management and Organization, Marketing and Sales, and Business Ethics and Communication. Students learn entrepreneurship, bookkeeping, budgeting, leadership, promotion, and professional communication.

entries.title: Mechanical & Automotive Engineering
entries.text: Mechanical & Automotive Engineering is available as diploma and certificate programmes. The curriculum includes Engine Fundamentals, Engine Systems, Transmission and Drivetrain, Suspension and Steering, Braking Systems, and Vehicle Maintenance and Repair. Topics include engine operation, fuel systems, gearboxes, steering, brakes, diagnostics, and maintenance.

entries.title: Electrical & Electronics Engineering
entries.text: Electrical & Electronics Engineering at Kiharu TVC includes diploma and certificate pathways. Students study Electrical Fundamentals, AC and DC Circuits, Electrical Installation, Electronics Basics, Power Distribution, and Electrical Safety and Maintenance. The programme covers wiring systems, transformers, semiconductors, safety, and troubleshooting.

entries.title: Computing & Informatics
entries.text: Computing & Informatics at Kiharu TVC offers diploma and certificate programmes. Modules include Computer Fundamentals, Programming Basics, Database Management, Networking, Web Development, and IT Support and Troubleshooting. Students learn hardware, operating systems, programming, SQL, networking, web design, and system administration.

entries.title: Fashion & Design
entries.text: Fashion & Design is offered at Kiharu TVC as a certificate programme. The curriculum includes Fashion Design Basics, Pattern Making, Garment Construction, Textile Design, Fashion Collections, and Fashion Business. Topics cover sketching, fabric knowledge, sewing, pattern drafting, printing, trend forecasting, and production management.

entries.title: Cosmetology
entries.text: Cosmetology at Kiharu TVC covers skin anatomy and care, hair care and styling, makeup application, nail care and design, health and safety, and salon operations. Students learn facial treatments, hair styling, makeup techniques, manicure and pedicure skills, hygiene standards, customer service, and salon management.

entries.title: Hospitality
entries.text: Hospitality at Kiharu TVC is offered as diploma and certificate programmes. The programme includes industry overview, reception duties, kitchen safety and food hygiene, table setting and service, room cleaning and maintenance, and event planning. It teaches customer relations, service standards, guest coordination, and hospitality operations.

entries.title: Social Work
entries.text: Social Work at Kiharu TVC is offered as a diploma programme. Modules include Social Work Values, Community Needs, Communication Skills, Child Protection, Mental Health Awareness, and Social Policy. Students learn ethics, stakeholder engagement, crisis intervention, family support, and advocacy.

entries.title: Tourism Management
entries.text: Tourism Management at Kiharu TVC is offered as diploma and certificate programmes. The programme covers Tourism Overview, Guide Preparation, Itinerary Planning, Destination Marketing, Property Management, and Adventure Activities. Students learn sustainable tourism, customer service, booking systems, marketing, and operations.
